text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Connecting" with everyone through races.
That is... truly sフィラ (sfira).

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "For Neo Universe, 'running' is 'METI'... Drawing an 'orbit' in 'outer space.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
